configuration.title: G4 Test Wright
description: A G4 bots test workbench for VS Code: discover the bots of a G4 project, build run plans with drag and drop, run them against the G4 engine, and review G4 and Allure reports.
viewsWelcome.g4TestWrightLauncher.0.cont:
Discover the bots of your G4 project, build a run plan, and run it against the G4 engine.
[Open Test Wright](command:TestWright.OpenNew)
Each click opens another Test Wright tab, so you can work on several plans at once. Each file under bots/ is a test and each subfolder is a suite. Runs are saved under reports/ with G4 and Allure reports.
New to Test Wright? Add a few practice bots to this project and follow the learning path.
[Add Practice Bots](command:TestWright.AddPracticeBots)
